dedupe_keys.name: what s the tee metrics of temperature extremes in europe nuts regions 1980 2024

description: What’s the TEE: Metrics of Temperature Extremes in Europe NUTS Regions (1980-2024) is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Sara R. Ronnkvist et al. We generate datasets quantifying extreme temperature exposure in Europe using a variety of metrics at two sub-national spatial scales (NUTS 2 and NUTS 3) and three temporal scales (daily, extreme temperature wave, and yearly) from 1980-2024. Coverage: continental; published in 2025. Formats: CSV. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 7268617396 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
